about_short_description.short_description: Fabheads Automation Providing innovative and cost-effective composite product fabrication solutions.

product.name: Continuous Fiber 3D Printing
product.description: A 3D printing process that fabricates composite products by layering continuous carbon fibers combined with thermoplastics to create strong, lightweight parts.

product.name: Composite Product Fabrication Services
product.description: Fabrication of high-performance composite parts using advanced manufacturing techniques including 3D printing and traditional composite layup methods.

product.name: 3D Printed Drone Components
product.description: Design and manufacture of drone structural parts including airframes, landing gears, wings, and propellers using 3D printing and composite materials.

product.name: Carbon Fiber Archimedes Screw
product.description: A lightweight, corrosion-resistant Archimedes screw fabricated using continuous carbon fiber composites and 3D printing techniques.

product.name: Design and Engineering Consultation
product.description: Consulting services for composite product design, fiber orientation optimization, and manufacturing process planning.
